arguments.query: SELECT b.id, b.status, b.request_id, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, c.id as charge_id, c.status as charge_status FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'pending'
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT b.booking_id, b.request_id, b.status, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents, c.charge_id, c.state FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'pending' ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.request_id, b.status, b.flight_id, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'pending' GROUP BY b.booking_id

SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.state, pl.state as provider_state FROM charges c LEFT JOIN provider_ledger pl ON c.idempotency_key = pl.idempotency_key WHERE c.state != 'captured' OR pl.state = 'pending'
SELECT charge_id, booking_id, state FROM charges WHERE state != 'captured'

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.state = 'captured' THEN 1 END) as captured_count, COUNT(r.refund_id) as refund_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON b.booking_id = r.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.state = 'captured' THEN 1 END) as captured_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING charge_count != 1 OR captured_count != 1

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(h.booking_id) as has_hold, COUNT(ch.booking_id) as has_checkin FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN checkins ch ON b.booking_id = ch.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING has_hold != 1 OR has_checkin != 1
SELECT b.booking_id, b.request_id, b.status FROM bookings b WHERE b.request_id IN ('req_1f69c1bd839a592db7e526fa5b120bac', 'req_d959370557ec57b28913b9cdd549be46')
